newsitem.title: MEXICO: Latam '96 steel production 20 mln tonnes-industry.
newsitem.headline: Latam '96 steel production 20 mln tonnes-industry.

text.p: Latin American steelmakers will export 20 million tonnes in 1996, an industry spokesman told journalists on Wednesday.

"Of the 50 million tonnes (to be made in 1996), industry exports will total about 20 million tonnes, compared with imports of seven million tonnes," said Roberto de Andraca, president of the Latin American Iron and Steel Institute (ILAF).
De Andraca said the 50 million tonnes to be produced in Latin America will account for 6.4 percent of world production, up from 3.5 percent 10 years ago.
